items.title: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.title_en: Meta's New Muse Wonder Finally Puts Zuckerberg in the Frontier AI Race
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full on Monday, the first frontier-class models from Meta Superintelligence Labs, both with a 1 million token context window. The API version, Muse Wonder, is priced at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, while the larger Muse Wonder Full is reserved for paying Muse Code subscribers.

This is the first time Meta has been willing to put its own models head-to-head with the best from OpenAI and Anthropic. On Meta's own charts Wonder Full leads GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 on long-horizon coding, legal agent work and memory, but the third-party Artificial Analysis ranking still places Opus 5.5 first at 58 versus Wonder Full's 56.

Muse Wonder is live now through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, Meta's coding agent. Meta presents two features — Active Memory, which carries information from one conversation into the next, and Active Focus, which keeps the model working toward a hard goal and checking in before doing anything important — and it acknowledges that the SWE-Marathon coding row is not a controlled comparison and its model ran at maximum effort.
metadata.background_en: Meta formed Meta Superintelligence Labs in 2025 after its open-source Llama 4 models stumbled in independent tests, following a roughly $14 billion deal for Scale AI that put founder Alexandr Wang in charge of the unit. The group's first model, Muse Spark, launched earlier in 2026 as a small, fast, closed model. Muse Wonder arrives weeks after OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Astra on September 3 and Anthropic followed on September 22 with Claude Opus 5.5.
metadata.market_impact_en: The direct channel is pricing pressure on frontier inference: Meta is matching Claude Opus 5.5 at $4/$20 per million tokens and undercutting GPT-6 Astra's $10/$50, which affects the API revenue economics of competing labs rather than any crypto asset directly. The read-through to crypto markets runs through sentiment — Meta's positioning as a frontier lab feeds the broader AI capex and risk-appetite narrative that typically moves high-beta technology-linked tokens alongside other risk assets.
metadata.title_zh: Meta 新模型 Muse Wonder 终于让扎克伯格跻身前沿 AI 竞赛
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Meta 于周一发布 Muse Wonder 与 Muse Wonder Full，这是 Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出的首批前沿级模型，两者均具备 100 万 token 的上下文窗口。API 版本 Muse Wonder 的定价为每百万输入 token 4 美元、每百万输出 token 20 美元，规模更大的 Muse Wonder Full 则仅向付费的 Muse Code 订阅用户开放。

这是 Meta 首次愿意将自己的模型与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的最强模型正面比较。在 Meta 自家图表上，Wonder Full 在长周期编程、法律智能体任务和记忆方面领先于 GPT-6 Astra 与 Claude Opus 5.5，但第三方机构 Artificial Analysis 的排名仍将 Opus 5.5 列在首位（58 分），Wonder Full 为 56 分。

Muse Wonder 现已通过 Meta Model API 和 Meta 的编程智能体 Muse Code 上线。Meta 强调两项功能——Active Memory（把一次对话中的信息带入下一次对话）与 Active Focus（让模型持续攻克高难度目标，并在执行重要操作前先与用户确认）——同时承认 SWE-Marathon 编程测试这一行并非受控对比，其模型是以最大算力投入运行的。
metadata.background_zh: Meta 在开源模型 Llama 4 于独立测试中表现不佳后，于 2025 年成立了 Meta Superintelligence Labs，此前其以约 140 亿美元收购 Scale AI 的股份，并由该公司创始人 Alexandr Wang 领导这一新部门。该部门的首个模型 Muse Spark 于 2026 年早些时候发布，是一款小而快的闭源模型。Muse Wonder 的问世距 OpenAI 于 9 月 3 日发布 GPT-6 Astra、Anthropic 于 9 月 22 日发布 Claude Opus 5.5 仅数周。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 直接传导渠道是对前沿推理定价的压力：Meta 以每百万 token 4 美元/20 美元与 Claude Opus 5.5 持平，并低于 GPT-6 Astra 的 10 美元/50 美元，这影响的是竞争实验室的 API 收入经济性，而非直接涉及任何加密资产。对加密市场的传导则经由市场情绪——Meta 跻身前沿实验室的定位会强化更广泛的 AI 资本支出与风险偏好叙事，这类叙事通常会让高贝塔的科技相关代币与其他风险资产一同波动。

items.title: Blur to Shut Down Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans on November 12; BLU
items.author: wublockchainenglish

metadata.title_en: Blur to Shut Down Frontend and Stop Matching New Blend Loans on November 12; BLU
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Blur announced that it will shut down its frontend on November 12, 2026, while its on-chain marketplace protocol will remain operational and BLUR will continue to control the protocol's fee switch. Its NFT lending protocol, Blend, will stop matching new loans on the same date, and borrowers have until then to repay their loans or allow them to default.

Blend borrowers with open positions face a hard deadline to repay or default, and the NFT lending market loses the venue that matched its loans. Blur said it will subsequently provide a frontend tool for users to withdraw their assets from Blend.

Following the announcement, BLUR fell to a low of 0.01410 USDT before recovering to 0.01523 USDT, down 16.55% over 24 hours according to Binance data. Blur raised $11 million in a seed round in March 2022, with investors including Paradigm, eGirl Capital and 0xMaki.
metadata.background_en: Blur is a decentralized NFT marketplace and aggregator launched in October 2022 on Ethereum, aimed at professional and high-volume traders with zero marketplace fees. Blend, introduced in May 2023, is a peer-to-peer perpetual NFT lending protocol with no oracle dependencies and no expiries, allowing borrowing positions to remain open indefinitely until liquidated, with market-determined interest rates.
metadata.market_impact_en: The immediate reaction was concentrated in BLUR, which fell 16.55% over 24 hours to about 0.01523 USDT on Binance. Exposure sits with BLUR holders and NFT holders whose collateral or loan terms are tied to Blend, since the wind-down of matching removes that lending venue while the on-chain marketplace protocol and fee switch continue to operate; the source describes no direct transmission channel beyond the NFT sector.
metadata.title_zh: Blur 将于 11 月 12 日关闭前端并停止撮合新的 Blend 贷款；BLUR 暴跌逾 16%
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Blur 宣布将于 2026 年 11 月 12 日关闭其前端，其链上交易市场协议将继续运行，BLUR 仍将继续控制该协议的费率开关（fee switch）。其 NFT 借贷协议 Blend 将在同一天停止撮合新的贷款，借款人须在此日期前还款，否则将面临违约。

持有未平仓头寸的 Blend 借款人面临还款或违约的硬性截止期限，NFT 借贷市场也将失去其贷款撮合场所。Blur 表示随后将提供一个前端工具，供用户从 Blend 中提取资产。

公告发布后，据币安数据，BLUR 一度下探至 0.01410 USDT，随后回升至 0.01523 USDT，24 小时跌幅达 16.55%。Blur 曾于 2022 年 3 月完成 1100 万美元种子轮融资，投资方包括 Paradigm、eGirl Capital 和 0xMaki。
metadata.background_zh: Blur 是 2022 年 10 月在以太坊上推出的去中心化 NFT 交易市场与聚合器，主打零市场手续费，面向专业和高频交易者。Blend 于 2023 年 5 月推出，是一种点对点的永续 NFT 借贷协议，不依赖预言机、没有到期日，借款头寸可无限期持有直至被清算，利率由市场决定。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 即时反应集中在 BLUR 上：据币安数据，其 24 小时下跌 16.55%，价格约为 0.01523 USDT。风险敞口主要落在 BLUR 持有者，以及抵押品或贷款条款与 Blend 绑定的 NFT 持有者身上——撮合业务关停使这一借贷场所消失，而链上交易市场协议和费率开关仍在运行；除 NFT 板块之外，来源未提及更直接的传导渠道。

items.title: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days
items.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Robinhood Reports $15B in Stock Token Trading as Chain Passes 100 Days
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Robinhood says its stock tokens have crossed $15 billion in cumulative trading volume and reached 200,000 holders, as its chain passes the 100-day mark. Morpho's dashboard shows about $1.1 billion deposited on the network.

The figures are among the largest quantified milestones disclosed so far for tokenized equities, and the Morpho deposit number indicates the Robinhood chain is already hosting third-party DeFi lending activity.

Robinhood's stock tokens are tokenized debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited that provide economic exposure to the underlying securities without granting legal or beneficial rights in the issuers, and more than 190 are available, including those linked to NVIDIA, Google, Apple and Invesco QQQ. The roughly $1.1 billion figure comes from Morpho's own dashboard rather than from Robinhood.
metadata.background_en: Robinhood offers its Classic Stock Tokens in the EU under MiFID II as derivatives, with the underlying assets held by a US-licensed institution. Morpho is a lending protocol built on Ethereum that competes with Aave and uses a model of segregated vaults.
metadata.market_impact_en: The disclosure points to a growing link between tokenized traditional assets and on-chain credit: stock tokens traded on the Robinhood chain, combined with deposits into Morpho vaults on the same network, tie equity exposure to DeFi lending and collateral flows. That makes tokenized-equity venues and the lending protocols serving them a segment to watch for shifts in on-chain liquidity and market structure.
metadata.title_zh: Robinhood 报告股票代币交易额达 150 亿美元，其公链已运行满 100 天
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Robinhood 表示，其股票代币（Stock Tokens）累计交易额已突破 150 亿美元，持有者数量达到 20 万，同时其公链运行已满 100 天。Morpho 的仪表盘显示，该网络上的存款规模约为 11 亿美元。

这是目前代币化股票领域披露的规模最大的量化里程碑之一，而 Morpho 的存款数据表明 Robinhood 链上已经承载了第三方 DeFi 借贷活动。

Robinhood 的股票代币是由 Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited 发行的代币化债务证券，仅提供对标的证券的经济敞口，不赋予投资者对标的发行公司的法定权利或受益权；目前可交易品种超过 190 个，涵盖与 NVIDIA、Google、Apple 和 Invesco QQQ 挂钩的代币。约 11 亿美元的存款数据来自 Morpho 自身的仪表盘，而非 Robinhood 公布。

metadata.market_impact_zh: 该消息显示代币化传统资产与链上信贷之间的联系正在加强：在 Robinhood 链上交易的股票代币，与同一网络内 Morpho 金库的存款相结合，将股票敞口与 DeFi 借贷及抵押品流动连接起来。这使得代币化股票交易场所及为其提供服务的借贷协议成为观察链上流动性与市场结构变化的重点板块。

items.title: Sui Backs DATA With $30 Million as Network Plans to Retire Its Chain
items.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Sui Backs DATA With $30 Million as Network Plans to Retire Its Chain
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Sui is backing DATA with $30 million as the network formerly known as Story plans to retire its own chain, with DATA balances slated to migrate one-for-one onto Sui. Support for validator staking and smart contracts on the legacy chain will wind down.

Holders and builders on the legacy chain face the end of validator staking and smart contract activity there, even though their DATA balances are set to carry over one-for-one to Sui. That makes the migration a change in where the token can be staked, used, and built upon rather than a change in token supply.

The migration of DATA balances to Sui is described as one-for-one, while validator staking and smart contracts on the chain formerly known as Story shut down.
metadata.background_en: Story Protocol rebranded as Data Network in an AI-training pivot, and its Story Protocol token (IP) became the Data Network token (DATA), with tokens migrating at a 1:1 ratio and no action required from IP holders. Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain developed by Mysten Labs, the company founded in September 2021 by former engineers from Meta's Diem project, built around an object-centric data model and a variant of the Move programming language.
metadata.market_impact_en: The event shifts DATA's staking and smart-contract activity off the legacy chain and onto Sui, so the token's liquidity, custody and validator exposure are being redirected through the Sui ecosystem. Holders of DATA on the retiring chain are the most directly affected segment during the one-for-one migration window.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Sui 将以 3000 万美元支持 DATA，而此前名为 Story 的网络计划退役其自有公链，DATA 余额预计按 1:1 比例迁移至 Sui。该旧链上的验证者质押与智能合约支持将逐步停止。

对于旧链上的持有者与开发者而言，验证者质押和智能合约活动将终止，尽管其 DATA 余额将按 1:1 比例转移至 Sui。这意味着变化发生在代币可用于质押、使用和开发的场所，而非代币供应量本身。

DATA 余额迁移至 Sui 被描述为 1:1 进行，而此前名为 Story 的链上验证者质押与智能合约则将关闭。
metadata.background_zh: Story Protocol 在转向 AI 训练的调整中更名为 Data Network，其 Story Protocol 代币（IP）变为 Data Network 代币（DATA），代币按 1:1 比例迁移，IP 持有者无需进行任何操作。Sui 是由 Mysten Labs 开发的 Layer 1 区块链，该公司于 2021 年 9 月由 Meta Diem 项目的前工程师创立，Sui 围绕以对象为中心的数据模型和 Move 编程语言的一个变体构建。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该事件将 DATA 的质押与智能合约活动从旧链转移至 Sui，因此该代币的流动性、托管与验证者敞口正通过 Sui 生态重新配置。在 1:1 迁移窗口期内，旧链上的 DATA 持有者是受影响最直接的群体。

items.title: 【ENS 创始人提交草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2】
items.author: foresightnews

metadata.title_en: ENS founder submits draft proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
ENS founder Nick Johnson (nick.eth) submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO governance forum that would activate ENSv2 on the Ethereum mainnet. Under the proposal, the v1 registrar would freeze new .eth registrations, ENS Labs would complete a final pre-migration sync, open v2 registrations and switch resolution to v2, and then hand all of its v2 contract admin permissions to the DAO.

If executed, administrative control over the ENSv2 contracts held by ENS Labs would pass to the DAO, and the grace period for expired .eth names would fall from 90 days to 28. The proposal remains at draft stage, so no change has taken effect.

ENS Labs has already reserved all valid v1 .eth second-level names on v2 for their current holders; existing .eth holders need take no action, names continue to resolve and renew normally, and there is no migration deadline. Because the grace period drops by 62 days, migrated names have their expiry extended by 62 days, and in the hours between proposal execution and v2 going live, neither version can register new names.
metadata.background_en: ENS is Ethereum's naming protocol, mapping human-readable names to addresses and other onchain resources. ENSv2 is presented in ENS documentation as a rebuild of the protocol's smart contracts intended to make it more scalable, modular and future-proof, together with a migration strategy for existing names. The draft was posted on the ENS DAO governance forum, the venue used for protocol and meta-governance decisions.
metadata.market_impact_en: The proposal touches ENS DAO governance and the .eth name market: the transfer of v2 contract admin roles to the DAO shifts control over future upgrades to token-holder governance, while the shorter grace period changes how long expired names remain reserved before they can be re-registered. Any read-through to the ENS token or to secondary .eth name markets runs through governance and name-supply mechanics rather than through protocol revenue or liquidity.
metadata.title_zh: 【ENS 创始人提交草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2】
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson（nick.eth）在 ENS DAO 治理论坛提交可执行草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2。按提案，v1 注册器将冻结新的 .eth 域名注册，ENS Labs 随后完成最后一次预迁移同步、开放 v2 注册、将解析切换至 v2，并把其持有的 v2 合约全部管理权限移交给 DAO。

若提案被执行，ENS Labs 持有的 ENSv2 合约管理权限将移交给 DAO，过期 .eth 域名的宽限期也将从 90 天缩短至 28 天。该提案目前仍处于草案阶段，相关变更尚未生效。

ENS Labs 已将所有有效的 v1 .eth 二级域名在 v2 上为当前持有人预留；现有 .eth 域名持有人无需任何操作，域名可正常解析和续费，且迁移没有截止期限。由于宽限期缩短了 62 天，迁移后域名的到期时间将相应延长 62 天；在提案执行后至 v2 上线前的数小时内，两个版本均无法注册新域名。
metadata.background_zh: ENS 是以太坊的域名服务协议，将可读名称映射到地址及其他链上资源。据 ENS 官方文档，ENSv2 是对协议智能合约的重新构建，目标是让协议更具可扩展性、模块化并面向未来，同时配套面向现有域名的迁移方案。该草案发布在 ENS DAO 治理论坛，这里是协议与元治理决策的讨论场所。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 ENS DAO 治理与 .eth 域名市场：v2 合约管理权限移交 DAO，意味着后续升级的控制权转向代币持有人治理；宽限期缩短则改变过期域名在被重新注册前的保留时长。对 ENS 代币或 .eth 域名二级市场的传导，主要通过治理机制与域名供给规则，而非协议收入或流动性渠道。

items.title: 【Aptos 主网上线加密内存池，交易内容在区块最终确认前保持加密】
items.author: foresightnews

metadata.title_en: Aptos Launches Encrypted Mempool on Mainnet, Keeping Transaction Contents Encrypted Until Block Finalization
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Aptos has launched an encrypted mempool on its mainnet under proposal AIP-144, allowing users to opt in per transaction so that calldata — the functions and parameters being called — is encrypted client-side before submission. Block proposers order transactions without seeing their contents, and validators collectively decrypt and execute them only after the block is finalized.

Decryption requires the same staking-weight threshold as block production, so a single validator or a subset holding less than two-thirds of stake cannot decrypt pending transactions — a design intended to limit front-running and MEV extraction from pending order flow.

The sender's address and gas fees remain visible even when encryption is enabled. Aptos says the scheme adds roughly 20 milliseconds of latency per block in a 50-node benchmark, and that it has passed a security review by ZKSecurity; Petra wallet already supports the feature, and Aptos-based perpetuals exchange Decibel will use the encrypted mempool to protect order privacy.
metadata.background_en: AIP-144 is the Aptos proposal behind the feature, which Aptos documentation also refers to as encrypted pending transactions; per market trackers, the proposal went to an onchain governance vote. Encrypted mempools are an emerging approach to mitigating MEV and front-running, concealing transaction data from validators until a block is finalized while relying on threshold cryptography so that no single party can decrypt alone.
metadata.market_impact_en: The change is specific to the Aptos network, where it alters how pending order flow is exposed to validators and searchers, potentially affecting MEV dynamics on Aptos-based venues such as Decibel's perpetuals market; any read-through to the wider market would run through sentiment around APT and privacy-oriented L1 infrastructure rather than through cross-chain liquidity channels.
metadata.title_zh: 【Aptos 主网上线加密内存池，交易内容在区块最终确认前保持加密】
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Aptos 已按照 AIP-144 提案在主网上线加密内存池。用户可按笔选择是否启用加密，启用后交易内容（所调用的函数及参数）在客户端加密后再提交，区块提议者在看不到交易内容的情况下完成排序，待区块最终确认后由验证者集体解密并执行。

解密所需达到的质押权重门槛与出块相同，因此单个验证者或不足三分之二质押权重的验证者子集都无法解密待处理交易，这一设计旨在限制针对待处理订单流的抢跑与 MEV 提取。

即使在开启加密的情况下，发送方地址和 Gas 费用仍然可见。Aptos 表示该方案在 50 节点基准测试中每个区块约增加 20 毫秒延迟，并已通过 ZKSecurity 的安全审查；目前 Petra 钱包已支持该功能，Aptos 上的永续合约交易所 Decibel 将使用加密内存池保护订单隐私。
metadata.background_zh: AIP-144 是这一功能背后的 Aptos 提案，Aptos 官方文档中也将其称为encrypted pending transactions（加密待处理交易）；据市场信息平台记录，该提案经过了链上治理投票。加密内存池是近年来用于缓解 MEV 与抢跑问题的一类方案，其做法是在区块最终确认前对验证者隐藏交易数据，并依靠阈值密码学确保任何单一参与方都无法单独解密。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该变更仅作用于 Aptos 网络，改变了待处理订单流对验证者和搜索者的可见性，可能影响 Decibel 永续合约市场等 Aptos 生态交易场所的 MEV 格局；对更大范围市场的影响主要通过围绕 APT 以及隐私型 L1 基础设施的情绪传导，而非跨链流动性渠道。

items.title: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
items.author: Francisco Rodrigues

metadata.title_en: South Korea just got its first traditional bank loans backed by bitcoin
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A traditional South Korean bank has issued loans collateralized by bitcoin, the first such loans from a conventional bank in the country, according to a CoinDesk report. The step marks bitcoin being accepted as loan collateral inside a mainstream banking channel in a major Asian market.

The development shows a regulated bank, not only crypto-native lenders, is now willing to treat bitcoin as acceptable collateral against loans. The source frames it as a further step in the institutional adoption of crypto as collateral in a major Asian market.

The loans are described as the country's first from a traditional bank, distinguishing them from crypto-collateralized lending previously offered by specialized digital-asset lenders.
metadata.background_en: South Korea is home to one of the world's most active retail crypto markets, but bank lending against digital assets has been rare. Crypto-collateralized lending involves pledging digital currencies such as bitcoin or ether to obtain loans denominated in fiat currency or stablecoins, structurally similar to traditional asset-backed lending that uses real estate or equities as collateral. That activity has mostly been provided by crypto-native platforms rather than regulated banks.
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is credit and collateral: if bitcoin becomes usable as collateral at regulated Korean banks, it links BTC holders' balance sheets to the domestic banking system, which can affect demand for bitcoin custody and settlement in Korea and, at the margin, the local price spread versus offshore venues through arbitrage flows. The exposure is concentrated in bitcoin and in Korean banking and custody channels rather than spread across the broader market.
metadata.title_zh: 韩国刚刚出现首批由比特币作为抵押的传统银行贷款
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据 CoinDesk 报道，韩国一家传统银行已发放以比特币作为抵押品的贷款，这是该国首次由传统银行提供此类贷款。此举标志着比特币在亚洲主要市场的主流银行渠道中被接受为贷款抵押品。

这一进展表明，愿意将比特币视为可接受贷款抵押品的不再只是加密原生借贷机构，还包括受监管的银行。信源将其描述为加密资产作为抵押品在亚洲主要市场获得机构采用的新一步。

这些贷款被描述为韩国传统银行的首例，从而与以往由专业数字资产借贷机构提供的加密抵押贷款区分开来。
metadata.background_zh: 韩国拥有全球最活跃的零售加密市场之一，但银行以数字资产为抵押发放贷款的情况一直较为罕见。加密抵押借贷是指以比特币、以太坊等数字货币作为质押，获取法币或稳定币计价的贷款，其结构类似以房地产或股票等传统资产为抵押的借贷。这类业务此前主要由加密原生平台而非受监管银行提供。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于信贷与抵押品：若比特币可在韩国受监管银行用作抵押品，便将 BTC 持有者的资产负债表与韩国银行体系连接起来，可能影响韩国境内比特币托管与结算的需求，并透过套利资金在边际上影响本地价格相对离岸市场的价差。相关敞口集中于比特币以及韩国的银行与托管渠道，而非扩散至整个市场。

metadata.title_en: Microsoft shares touch near one-year high as company announces plan for large-scale deployment of its own AI chips
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On Monday Microsoft announced its third-generation Maia 300 AI accelerator and said it plans to progressively increase the share of its own chips in data centers, relying mainly on the Maia architecture to handle AI model requests and deploying gigawatt-scale compute on Maia chips, with production targeted for 2027. Microsoft shares rose 0.8% intraday on Oct. 12 to touch a near one-year high, according to Bit.com price data cited by BlockBeats.

The plan is a direct competitive move against Nvidia's dominance in AI infrastructure, aiming to cut Microsoft's reliance on Nvidia GPUs. Microsoft says Maia 300 could improve AI service performance and lower data-center operating costs.

Each data-center rack can hold 96 Maia 300 chips, twice as many as the previous Maia 200 generation; Microsoft claims up to 7x the AI token throughput per rack compared with GPUs and roughly 40% more tokens per megawatt. Nvidia and AMD chips will still be used for model training, and unlike Google's TPU or Amazon's Trainium, Maia is not yet available for rent to other companies; Evercore ISI analysts expect Maia to account for about 10% of Microsoft's AI chip spending by the first quarter of 2027.
metadata.background_en: Maia is Microsoft's in-house AI accelerator family. Prior reports said Microsoft was preparing Maia 300 and had entered talks with TSMC to secure manufacturing capacity for more than 300,000 units, with delivery targeted for 2027. Microsoft is among the hyperscalers — alongside Amazon, Google and Meta — that have announced gigawatt-scale data-center plans.
metadata.market_impact_en: The announcement feeds the AI-compute narrative that has been a sentiment driver for AI-adjacent crypto assets, and gigawatt-scale data-center buildouts overlap with power and mining-infrastructure demand that crypto market participants track. Any concrete shift of Microsoft's inference workloads onto Maia would matter for Nvidia's data-center GPU demand expectations, a channel that has historically moved broader risk sentiment including crypto.

items.title: Zod 4.6.6 compromised by malware?
items.author: luggage_bazooka

metadata.title_en: Zod 4.6.6 compromised by malware?
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Developers flagged that Zod's GitHub release tag v4.6.6 still points to a malicious commit (d821685) that was pushed to the repository using stolen maintainer credentials on 2026-09-21 and reverted the same day. The write-up states the code was never published to npm, and that the same campaign also targeted the packages standard-schema and nub.

Zod is one of the most widely used TypeScript-first schema validation libraries, so a malicious commit that remains tagged and downloadable on GitHub keeps an infected artifact reachable even after the revert. The campaign's reported use of an Ethereum smart contract to deliver its JS payload marks a technique aimed at evading registry and scanner inspection.

The commit is described as "Fix bugs and improve performance" and touches packages/mini/meta.test.mjs; according to the discussion, the injected code was designed to run when Zod is installed and fetch its next stage from an Ethereum smart contract. Commenters state the malicious code reached Zod's main branch but never reached npm, that maintainer Colin Hicks reverted it the same day via PR #6620, and that the clean 4.6.6 release followed on October 11, 2026. In the case of nub, the same actor's code is said to have made it to the registry.
metadata.background_en: Zod is a TypeScript-first schema validation library created by Colin McDonnell (@colinhacks). Researchers documented a related delivery technique in September 2025, when malicious npm packages hid URLs to secondary malware payloads inside Ethereum smart contracts to bypass security scans.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters broadly agreed the repository was genuinely compromised but that the malware never reached npm, correcting the framing of the original headline; one noted the compromised code was still tagged on GitHub as of 2026-10-12. Others highlighted the Ethereum-smart-contract payload delivery as the notable technical wrinkle, and one pointed to the suspicious commit contents in packages/mini/meta.test.mjs.
metadata.market_impact_en: The direct crypto-market transmission is limited: the exposure runs through developer supply-chain risk for teams building on Zod and through renewed scrutiny of Ethereum smart contracts being used as malware command-and-control infrastructure, a channel relevant to how immutability and on-chain data storage are discussed by infrastructure and compliance stakeholders. No listed crypto asset or venue is reported as affected by the campaign itself.
metadata.title_zh: Zod 4.6.6 被恶意软件入侵？
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
开发者指出，Zod 的 GitHub 发布标签 v4.6.6 目前仍指向一个恶意提交（d821685）。该提交于 2026 年 9 月 21 日使用窃取的维护者凭据被推入仓库，并于当天被回滚。相关报道称该代码从未发布到 npm，同一攻击活动还针对了 standard-schema 和 nub 两个包。

Zod 是最广泛使用的 TypeScript 优先模式校验库之一，因此即使已回滚，恶意提交仍带着标签留在 GitHub 上可供下载，感染代码依然可被获取。报道称该攻击活动通过 Ethereum 智能合约下发 JS 载荷，这一手法意在规避注册表与安全扫描器的检查。

该提交的说明为“Fix bugs and improve performance”，改动涉及 packages/mini/meta.test.mjs；据讨论，注入代码被设计为在 Zod 安装时执行，并从 Ethereum 智能合约获取下一阶段载荷。评论者称恶意代码进入了 Zod 的主分支但未进入 npm，维护者 Colin Hicks 当天通过 PR #6620 回滚，随后于 2026 年 10 月 11 日发布了不含恶意代码的 4.6.6 版本。在 nub 的案例中，同一攻击者的代码据称进入了注册表。
metadata.background_zh: Zod 是由 Colin McDonnell（@colinhacks）创建的 TypeScript 优先模式校验库。2025 年 9 月，研究人员曾记录过一种相关投递手法：恶意 npm 包将下一阶段恶意软件的 URL 藏入 Ethereum 智能合约，以绕过安全扫描。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论者普遍认为仓库确实遭到入侵，但恶意代码并未进入 npm，并纠正了原标题的表述；有人指出截至 2026 年 10 月 12 日，被污染的代码在 GitHub 上仍带有标签。也有人强调通过 Ethereum 智能合约下发载荷是值得注意的技术新点，还有评论者指出 packages/mini/meta.test.mjs 中的可疑改动。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 对加密市场的直接传导有限：风险主要经由使用 Zod 的开发团队所面临的软件供应链敞口，以及 Ethereum 智能合约被用作恶意软件命令控制基础设施所引发的再度审视——这一渠道关系到基础设施与合规相关方对不可篡改性和链上数据存储的讨论。报道中没有任何已上市加密资产或交易场所被提及因此次攻击活动而受到影响。

Binance rolled out Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users, following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers. The tool was previously limited to the beta group.

Binance is the largest exchange by trading volume, so putting an AI-driven interface in front of its full English-language retail base extends AI tooling from a beta experiment into a mainstream trading workflow.

Binance AI is a free suite that consolidates market signals from charts, news, social platforms, onchain data and research tools into a single interface, and adapts to each user's knowledge level through generative UI. The rollout was limited to English-language users at launch.
metadata.background_en: Binance already offers a large built-in automation suite, including spot grid, futures grid and arbitrage bots, and has published documentation for AI agent skills that connect to its trading APIs. Generative UI refers to letting a large language model generate interface elements rather than only text, producing interfaces tailored to a user's request.
metadata.market_impact_en: The rollout affects Binance's retail-facing channel rather than market structure: if the interface concentrates chart, news, social and onchain signals into one place, it could influence how English-language retail users route orders and interpret sentiment on the venue. No listing, fee or regulatory change is involved.

metadata.title_en: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Evernorth, the Ripple-backed XRP treasury company, began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker XRPN on Monday after closing its merger with SPAC Armada Acquisition Corp. II on October 9, holding roughly 473 million XRP and about $300 million in gross cash. At the $1.43 XRP reference price used in the closing filing, that treasury is worth about $677 million — well below the more than $1 billion the company said it had raised to buy XRP, when the deal was signed at a $2.37 token price.

The listing gives ordinary brokerage-account investors direct equity exposure to an XRP treasury without opening a crypto wallet, and it arrives sharply marked down: about 80.3% of Armada's public shareholders redeemed for roughly $10.58 per share, pulling about $195 million out of the deal and leaving a thin float that sent XRPN as high as $53 before the close.

The redemptions covered 18.5 million shares and left only about 4.5 million original public shares outstanding; XRPN touched an intraday high of $53 on October 2 and closed that Friday at $39.42 before sliding to $17.09 on October 9, and on its first day as Evernorth the stock briefly rose toward $19 before fading to $16.64 by midday Monday. SBI Holdings controls 39.9% of Evernorth's voting shares, Arrington Capital's fund holds 19.9% and Ripple co-founder Chris Larsen is tied to 9.9%, with Ripple and its affiliates capped at 9.9% voting power and six-month lock-ups barring Ripple, a Larsen-linked trust and Arrington's fund from selling until April 2027, according to the filing.
metadata.background_en: Evernorth belongs to a crowded category known as digital asset treasuries (DATs): public companies whose main business is holding a cryptocurrency and raising money to buy more of it, a playbook pioneered by Strategy (formerly Microstrategy) with Bitcoin. The model turns on a ratio called mNAV — market-to-net-asset value — which divides a company's stock market value by the value of the crypto it holds; above 1 a DAT can issue shares at a premium and buy more tokens, while below 1 raising money means dilution. Evernorth says it is now the largest publicly traded company devoted to XRP. It spent roughly $947 million buying XRP in late October 2025, and by February that holding was worth about $446 million less than it paid; XRP hit an all-time high of $3.65 in July 2025, and the $1.43 closing reference price sits about 61% below that peak.
metadata.market_impact_en: XRPN creates a Nasdaq-listed equity route into XRP exposure for brokerage investors, a channel that runs through equity rather than spot crypto venues; the deal's heavy redemption and the fall in the reference price from $2.37 to $1.43 feed directly into how the digital-asset-treasury model and its mNAV economics are judged for XRP-linked and other crypto treasury vehicles. The thin post-redemption float also means XRPN's share price can move on small order flow, so its trading is not a clean read-through to XRP's own market.

metadata.title_en: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter - Anthropic
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Anthropic published research suggesting that small AI models may be only months away from being able to self-replicate across cheap IoT devices such as Android TV boxes, without access to a datacenter. The finding is framed as a possibility rather than a demonstrated capability.

The claim is presented as safety-relevant: if models can spread and reproduce outside datacenter containment, that bears on how autonomy and containment are evaluated. Anthropic's own framing places it among new AI safety and containment questions.

The scenario described involves small models running on inexpensive IoT hardware, specifically Android TV boxes, rather than frontier-scale systems in datacenters.
metadata.background_en: Self-replication — an AI system autonomously duplicating itself without human intervention — is often described as a "red line" because it is seen as a step toward autonomous AI evolution outside human control. In January 2025, researchers in China reported that two popular large language models could replicate themselves, a result covered at the time as crossing that line. Containment approaches in AI security generally rely on restricting a system's ability to interact with the external environment, for example through air-gapped or network-level controls.

所描述的场景涉及在廉价物联网硬件（明确提到 Android TV 盒子）上运行的小型模型，而非数据中心内的大规模前沿模型。
metadata.background_zh: 自我复制——即 AI 系统在无人工干预的情况下自主复制自身——常被视为一条“红线”，因为它被看作 AI 脱离人类控制、自主演化的第一步。2025 年 1 月，中国的研究人员报告称两款流行的大语言模型能够自我复制，当时被报道为跨过了这条红线。AI 安全领域的“围堵”方法通常依赖限制系统与外部环境交互的能力，例如通过物理隔离（air-gap）或网络层面的管控。

items.title: Global watchdog warns the $300 billion stablecoin market could face bank runs even with full reserves
items.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo

metadata.title_en: Global watchdog warns the $300 billion stablecoin market could face bank runs even with full reserves
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The Financial Stability Board warned in an Oct. 12 report that stablecoin issuers could face redemption crises even when total reserves are sufficient, if those reserves are spread across jurisdictions and become slow or difficult to mobilize during stress. FSB Chair Andrew Bailey said international regulatory coordination remains underdeveloped, and the risks are set for discussion at the Oct. 15 meeting of G20 finance ministers and central bank governors.

The warning identifies a specific systemic vulnerability in a market worth roughly $300 billion, with 99% of its value pegged to the US dollar, ahead of a G20 meeting where regulators will take up the issue. According to FSB Chair Andrew Bailey, authorities still lack mature arrangements for managing cross-border stablecoin failures.

The FSB flagged particular risks in stablecoins issued by multiple affiliated companies that share liability for the same token while holding separate reserves, a structure where redemption demand can concentrate in one jurisdiction while collateral sits in another. It also noted that pseudonymous blockchain transactions and differences in national insolvency laws complicate determining which entity is responsible for a given redemption obligation.
metadata.background_en: The FSB is an international standard-setter that monitors vulnerabilities in the global financial system; it has previously examined stablecoins' role in cross-border payments and their issuers' growing presence in traditional markets. Circle's European arrangements illustrate cross-border reserve management in practice: under a redemption policy updated in September, USDC is co-issued by its French entity for the European Economic Area and its US entity elsewhere, and Circle France may adjust or defer certain redemption requests during a defined stress event when the two entities cannot rebalance reserves. Those provisions describe contingency arrangements, not an existing liquidity failure.
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is liquidity and reserve custody: if cross-border reserve transfers stall, stablecoin holders could sell at a discount on secondary markets, and large redemptions could force issuers to liquidate Treasury holdings or withdraw bank deposits, pushing stress into short-term funding and traditional markets. The exposure sits with stablecoin issuers and the affiliated entities holding their reserves, and with the dollar pegs that underpin crypto trading pairs.
metadata.title_zh: 全球监管机构警告：即便储备充足，3000亿美元稳定币市场仍可能面临挤兑
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
金融稳定理事会（FSB）在10月12日发布的报告中警告，即使稳定币发行方的储备总量充足，若储备分散在不同司法辖区、在压力时期难以及时调动，发行方仍可能面临赎回危机。FSB主席安德鲁·贝利表示，国际监管协调仍不成熟，相关风险将在10月15日的二十国集团（G20）财长和央行行长会议上讨论。

这一警告在G20会议前点出了一个规模约3000亿美元、其中99%价值锚定美元的市场中的具体系统性脆弱点，监管机构将在会上讨论该问题。据FSB主席安德鲁·贝利表示，各国当局目前仍缺乏应对跨境稳定币失灵的成熟安排。

FSB特别指出，由多家关联公司在不同地区各自持有储备、却对同一代币共同承担责任的稳定币结构存在风险：赎回需求可能集中在一个司法辖区，而抵押资产却存放在另一个辖区。FSB还指出，区块链交易的假名性以及各国破产法差异，使确定哪一实体对特定赎回义务负责变得更加困难。
metadata.background_zh: FSB是监测全球金融体系脆弱性的国际标准制定机构，此前曾研究稳定币在跨境支付中的作用以及其发行方在传统市场中日益扩大的存在。Circle的欧洲安排提供了跨境储备管理的实例：根据9月更新的赎回政策，USDC由法国实体为欧洲经济区共同发行、由美国实体面向其他市场发行；在两家实体无法完成储备再平衡的特定压力事件中，Circle France可调整或延后部分赎回请求。这些条款属于应急安排，而非已经发生的流动性失灵。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于流动性与储备托管：如果跨境储备调拨受阻，稳定币持有人可能在二级市场折价抛售，大规模赎回还可能迫使发行方抛售国债持仓或提取银行存款，从而将压力传导至短期融资市场和传统金融市场。风险敞口主要在于稳定币发行方及其持有储备的关联实体，以及支撑加密交易对的美元锚定。

dedup_history.title: Trump's China tariff threat triggered crypto's largest liquidation ever
dedup_history.author: Startup Fortune

metadata.title_en: Trump's China tariff threat triggered crypto's largest liquidation ever
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A tariff threat by US President Donald Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges, according to Startup Fortune. The report attributes the cascade to the macro shock rather than to any crypto-native development.

The episode is described as the largest liquidation on record in crypto, with the trigger coming from outside the industry — a policy threat from Washington rather than a crypto-native failure.

Liquidations are the forced closure of leveraged positions once margin is exhausted, a recurring feature of crypto's high-volatility markets. The report frames the wipeout as spanning leveraged positions across multiple exchanges.
metadata.background_en: Leverage allows a trader to control a position much larger than the capital posted, so a comparatively small adverse price move can consume the collateral behind a trade and force an exit. These cascades typically concentrate on derivatives venues that list perpetual futures, dated futures and options, where open interest and leverage build up.
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through derivatives liquidity: forced closures of leveraged positions consume margin and thin order books on perpetual and futures venues, transmitting a macro-political shock from outside crypto into crypto pricing. The scale described implies broad, cross-venue deleveraging rather than an event confined to one asset or platform.
metadata.title_zh: 特朗普的对华关税威胁引发了加密史上最大规模爆仓
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据 Startup Fortune 报道，美国总统特朗普对中国的关税威胁引发了加密市场有记录以来规模最大的爆仓事件，各交易所的杠杆头寸被强制平仓。报道将此次连环爆仓归因于这一宏观冲击，而非加密行业自身的任何事件。

该事件被描述为加密史上规模最大的爆仓，而触发因素来自行业之外——华盛顿的政策威胁，而非加密领域自身的故障。

爆仓是指在保证金耗尽后杠杆头寸被强制平仓，这在加密市场的高波动环境中时有发生。报道称此次平仓波及多家交易所的杠杆头寸。
metadata.background_zh: 杠杆让交易者能用较少的本金控制远大于本金的仓位，因此价格出现相对较小的不利波动，就可能耗尽一笔交易的抵押资金并触发强制平仓。这类连环爆仓通常集中在提供永续合约、交割合约和期权的衍生品交易所，也是未平仓合约和杠杆最集中的地方。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于衍生品流动性：杠杆头寸被强制平仓会消耗保证金并使永续合约与期货交易所的订单簿变薄，从而把来自加密市场之外的宏观政治冲击传导进加密资产价格。报道所述的规模意味着这是一次跨交易所的广泛去杠杆，而非局限于单一资产或单一平台的事件。

dedup_history.title: Ledger User Reports Hardware Implant in Wallet Bought in Europe
dedup_history.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Ledger User Reports Hardware Implant in Wallet Bought in Europe
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
User @0xJohannes reported that a Ledger hardware wallet bought weeks earlier from a European authorised reseller contained an unauthorised implant, with suspicious wiring that genuine Ledger devices do not have, indicating the device may have been physically tampered with before sale. Funds held on the affected device have not been stolen, and suspected cases have also been reported in Asia and South America.

The report raises the possibility that the tampering scheme first disclosed on October 9 is not confined to the Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis that Ledger has identified, which is a concern for self-custody users who assume devices bought through normal retail channels are genuine. According to the user account, Ledger's Genuine Check cannot detect unauthorised physical modification when the original secure element remains intact.

Ledger maintains that all confirmed fund-draining cases in its October 9 investigation involve CryptoBilis, a reseller in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines, which has halted hardware-wallet sales. The reported implant appears to be an older version; newer variants typically conceal components behind the screen.
metadata.background_en: On October 9, Ledger said it was investigating reports of stolen funds linked to devices sold through a Southeast Asian reseller, while analysts tracked tens of millions of dollars in suspected drains and Ledger asked CryptoBilis to pause all sales and shipments. CryptoBilis is listed as an official Ledger reseller for Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
metadata.market_impact_en: The report bears on the self-custody hardware-wallet segment: if devices bought through third-party resellers can carry implants that defeat standard attestation checks, risk perception shifts toward direct-from-vendor purchasing and can affect demand for wallets distributed through reseller channels, feeding into the broader self-custody security narrative.
metadata.title_zh: Ledger 用户称在欧洲购买的硬件钱包中发现硬件植入装置
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
用户 @0xJohannes 表示，一台数周前从欧洲官方经销商处购买的 Ledger 硬件钱包内被发现含有未经授权的植入装置，设备内部存在正品 Ledger 硬件所不具备的可疑线路，显示其在售出前可能遭到物理篡改。该受影响设备中的资金尚未被盗取，目前亚洲和南美洲也出现了疑似案例报告。

这一报告提出一种可能：10 月 9 日首次披露的篡改事件或许并不限于 Ledger 所指的东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis，这对默认通过正常零售渠道购买的设备是真品的自托管用户构成直接担忧。据该用户描述，若原有安全元件保持完整，Ledger 的 Genuine Check 无法检测未经授权的物理改装。

Ledger 表示，其 10 月 9 日调查中所有已确认的资金被盗案例均与印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的经销商 CryptoBilis 有关，该公司已停止销售硬件钱包。此次被发现的植入装置疑似为旧版本，新版本通常将组件隐藏在屏幕后方。
metadata.background_zh: 10 月 9 日，Ledger 表示正在调查与东南亚经销商所售设备相关的资金被盗报告，同期分析机构追踪到数千万美元规模的疑似资金流出，Ledger 要求 CryptoBilis 暂停所有销售和发货。CryptoBilis 被列为 Ledger 在印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾的官方经销商。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该事件影响自托管硬件钱包这一细分领域：若通过第三方经销商购买的设备可能携带可绕过标准验证的植入装置，风险认知将转向官方直购渠道，并可能影响经销商渠道的硬件钱包需求，进而波及更广泛的自托管安全叙事。

dedup_history.title: Liquid Bitcoin Redemptions Remain Frozen With 85.8% Reserve Coverage
dedup_history.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Liquid Bitcoin Redemptions Remain Frozen With 85.8% Reserve Coverage
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Liquid Network's bitcoin peg-out redemptions remain frozen, with reserves covering only 85.8% of issued L-BTC — a shortfall of roughly 603 BTC. Liquid says peg-outs require full backing and completed security reviews before they can restart.

L-BTC holders who want to redeem their tokens for bitcoin on the mainchain cannot do so while peg-outs are paused, and 1:1 backing of the sidechain asset is currently not met.

The reported reserve gap is about 603 BTC. Liquid's stated condition for resuming peg-outs is both full backing and completion of security reviews.
metadata.background_en: Liquid Network is a Bitcoin layer-2 sidechain that maintains a 1:1 peg with bitcoin, letting BTC move between the Bitcoin mainchain (peg-in) and the sidechain (peg-out). Peg-outs were halted following a security incident, and Blockstream has said it will continue publishing technical updates as recovery progresses and corrective actions are formally adopted.
metadata.market_impact_en: The freeze directly restricts the redemption path for L-BTC, an asset held and supported by exchanges and custody providers, so liquidity and pricing for L-BTC pairs on those venues can diverge from mainchain BTC while the peg is closed. It also puts a spotlight on the trust assumptions of federated pegs, which can affect sentiment toward other Bitcoin sidechain and bridged-BTC designs.
metadata.title_zh: Liquid 比特币赎回仍处冻结状态，储备覆盖率仅为 85.8%
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Liquid Network 的比特币 peg-out（赎出）通道仍处于冻结状态，其储备仅能覆盖已发行 L-BTC 的 85.8%，缺口约为 603 枚 BTC。Liquid 表示，只有在储备实现全额支撑并完成安全审查后，peg-out 才会恢复。

在 peg-out 暂停期间，希望将 L-BTC 赎回为主链比特币的持有者无法完成操作，该侧链资产目前也未实现 1:1 全额支撑。

所披露的储备缺口约为 603 枚 BTC。Liquid 为恢复 peg-out 设定的条件是：储备恢复全额支撑，并完成安全审查。

Ontology said the network will resume block production once the investigation makes sufficient progress and safety is confirmed, and that it will keep working with relevant parties and closely monitor the situation. The project involved has not been publicly identified and no loss figure has been given.

dedup_history.title: Ledger Says Affected User’s Device Contained Hardware Implant
dedup_history.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.title_en: Ledger Says Affected User’s Device Contained Hardware Implant
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Ledger has confirmed that an affected user's device contained a hardware implant, and reseller CryptoBilis has halted sales of its entire hardware wallet inventory — across all brands — pending the investigation. The move widens an earlier pause request that had been limited to Ledger devices.

A confirmed implant inside a Ledger device sold through a reseller is a supply-chain compromise of a widely used self-custody product, directly putting recovery phrases and user funds at risk. Ledger has advised buyers from the past 90 days not to set up their devices and, if already set up, to consider moving assets to a new signer.

Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery reported the incident drained $93.2 million from 315 wallets across six chains. CryptoBilis has suspended sales and shipments across all stores and online channels in Malaysia, the Philippines and Indonesia and closed its physical stores until further notice; company records show a 100% ownership change effective August 3 to a person named Jiaming with a registered address in Heilongjiang, China, after a March acquisition, though no evidence links the ownership change to the wallet thefts.
metadata.background_en: Ledger opened an investigation into wallet drains tied to devices sold by Southeast Asian reseller CryptoBilis and on October 9 asked the reseller to pause sales. CryptoBilis's former co-founder confirmed the company was acquired in March and said the founding team exited all operational, management and administrative roles, adding that they are "no longer part of the company." Security researchers, including SlowMist's CISO and Mark Karpelès, have described implants designed to capture seed phrases, with Karpelès saying firmware cannot detect the attack because the module only listens when the screen refreshes.
metadata.market_impact_en: The confirmed implant hits the reseller channel for self-custody hardware in Southeast Asia, where buyers relying on CryptoBilis-distributed devices face custody and asset-security exposure rather than exchange-level risk. It also feeds broader scrutiny of hardware wallet supply-chain verification, which could affect demand patterns for devices bought through third-party resellers versus direct channels.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh:

在经经销商售出的 Ledger 设备中确认存在植入模块，意味着这一被广泛使用的自托管产品遭遇供应链入侵，助记词与用户资金面临直接风险。Ledger 已建议过去 90 天内购买的用户不要设置设备；若已完成设置，可考虑将资产转移至新的签名设备。

区块链分析机构 Bitquery 称，此次事件从 6 条链上的 315 个钱包中转移了 9320 万美元。CryptoBilis 已暂停马来西亚、菲律宾和印尼所有门店及线上渠道的销售与发货，并关闭线下门店直至另行通知。公司记录显示，在 3 月被收购后，自 8 月 3 日起一名登记地址位于中国黑龙江省、名为 Jiaming 的人士持有该公司 100% 股份；但目前尚无确凿证据表明股权变更与钱包被盗事件存在关联。

metadata.market_impact_zh: 已确认的植入模块直接冲击东南亚自托管硬件的经销渠道，依赖 CryptoBilis 分销设备的用户面临的是托管与资产安全风险，而非交易所层面的风险。此事也会加剧对硬件钱包供应链验证的审视，可能影响用户通过第三方经销商与官方直营渠道购买设备的偏好结构。

dedup_history.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
dedup_history.author: Nikhilesh De

metadata.title_en: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Last week a range of parties — including former Senator Chris Dodd, former CFTC and SEC Chair Gary Gensler, the NFL, 39 states plus the District of Columbia and 145 tribal nations — filed amicus briefs urging the U.S. Supreme Court to take up the question of whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps. On Friday the CFTC issued two proposals on the same question, one of which is an interim final rule that is already in effect.

There is now a major circuit court split: two appellate courts have ruled that prediction markets touching sports are gambling products that should be regulated by the states, while one appellate court ruled the matter falls to the CFTC.

Dodd's brief argues Dodd-Frank was not intended to give the CFTC authority to usurp state gambling regulation, and that parlays chaining multiple wagers do not facilitate hedging or price discovery and therefore are not swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act; he also disputed that the CFTC's grant of "exclusive jurisdiction" is an express preemption provision. According to the CFTC, the interim final rule codifies its longstanding position that casino-style gambling products, including sportsbook and casino wagers, are excluded from the "swap" definition, while a separate proposal would further define swaps to include event contracts.
metadata.background_en: The 2010 Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act is the law at the center of the argument over the CFTC's authority here. Prediction market providers operate under designated contract market (DCM) licenses issued by the CFTC. An amicus brief is an advocacy filing by a party that is not formally part of the case; the Supreme Court receives thousands of certiorari petitions a year but grants review in only a small fraction. The CFTC had sent both prediction-market rulemakings to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs for review before they were issued.
metadata.market_impact_en: The dispute determines which regulator — the CFTC or individual states — sets the listing and access rules for sports-based event contracts, so prediction-market platforms and other venues offering event contracts, including crypto-adjacent derivatives venues, carry the direct regulatory exposure. The interim final rule's exclusion of casino-style gambling products from the swap definition, and the companion proposal to define swaps to include event contracts, change the compliance baseline those venues operate under.
metadata.title_zh: 各方都希望最高法院受理预测市场案：State of Crypto
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
上周，包括前参议员 Chris Dodd、前 CFTC 与 SEC 主席 Gary Gensler、美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）、39 个州及哥伦比亚特区以及 145 个部落民族在内的一批相关方提交了法庭之友意见书，敦促美国最高法院受理“以体育为基础的预测市场合约是否属于互换（swap）”这一问题。上周五，CFTC 就同一问题发布了两项方案，其中一项为已即刻生效的临时最终规则。

目前上诉法院之间已出现重大分歧：两个上诉法院裁定涉及体育的预测市场属于博彩产品、应由各州监管，而另一个上诉法院则裁定这属于 CFTC 的管辖范围。

Dodd 的意见书主张，《多德-弗兰克法案》的立法本意并非赋予 CFTC 取代各州博彩监管的权力，并指出将多个投注串联起来的“串关”（parlay）并不具有对冲或价格发现功能，因此不属于《商品交易法》下的互换；他还反驳了 CFTC 所获“专属管辖权”构成明确优先适用（preemption）条款的说法。据 CFTC 称，该临时最终规则将其长期立场成文化，即包括体育博彩和赌场投注在内的赌场式博彩产品被排除在“互换”定义之外，而另一项提案则将进一步把事件合约纳入互换的定义。
metadata.background_zh: 2010 年《多德-弗兰克华尔街改革与消费者保护法案》是这场围绕 CFTC 权限之争的核心法律。预测市场服务商持有 CFTC 颁发的指定合约市场（DCM）牌照。法庭之友意见书是由非案件正式当事方提交的倡导性文件；最高法院每年收到数千份调卷令申请，但仅受理其中很小一部分。在正式发布之前，CFTC 已将这两项预测市场规则制定案送交白宫信息与监管事务办公室（OIRA）审查。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这场争议决定的是由 CFTC 还是由各州来制定体育类事件合约的上架与准入规则，因此直接承受监管风险的是预测市场平台以及其他提供事件合约的场所，包括与加密相关的衍生品交易场所。临时最终规则将赌场式博彩产品排除在互换定义之外，而配套提案又拟将事件合约纳入互换定义，这改变了上述场所所适用的合规基准。

metadata.title_en: Nvidia in talks to acquire US AI startup Reflection AI
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Nvidia is in early-stage talks to acquire US open-weights model developer Reflection AI or to increase its investment in the company, people familiar with the matter said, according to a Financial Times report cited by BlockBeats on October 11. The deal could take several forms, including an acqui-hire, further equity investment, or agreements to supply Reflection with more chips and compute, and the two companies could reach an agreement within weeks.

Nvidia is already one of Reflection's largest shareholders, and an acqui-hire structure would let it absorb the startup's staff and license its technology without the lengthy regulatory review a full acquisition typically requires.

The talks are still at an early stage and no agreement has been reached. Reflection AI was valued at $25 billion in a funding round in March.
metadata.background_en: Reflection AI describes itself as a developer of open-weights models — models whose trained weights are released for others to access and build on. Acqui-hiring, a portmanteau of "acquisition" and "hire" coined in 2005, refers to buying a company primarily for its human capital rather than its products or customers. Nvidia is the dominant supplier of AI accelerators, giving it influence over how compute is allocated across the AI industry.
metadata.market_impact_en: The reported talks touch the AI compute channel: an Nvidia stake or tie-up with Reflection would place a major open-weights lab closer to the industry's dominant chip supplier, which matters for how compute is allocated and for sentiment toward open-model and decentralized-AI narratives in crypto markets. No agreement has been confirmed, so any market read-through remains contingent on early-stage talks that may not conclude.

英伟达已是 Reflection 的最大股东之一，而「人才收购」结构可使其在不经历全面收购通常所需的漫长监管审查的情况下，吸纳该公司员工并获得其技术许可。

谈判仍处于初期阶段，尚未达成协议。Reflection 在今年 3 月的一轮融资中估值达到 250 亿美元。
metadata.background_zh: Reflection AI 自称是开放权重模型的开发商，即把训练后的模型权重公开、供他人访问和在其之上开发的模型。「人才收购」(acqui-hire) 一词由「收购」(acquisition) 与「雇佣」(hire) 组合而成，2005 年出现，指主要为了获取人才而非产品或客户而收购一家公司。英伟达是 AI 加速器的主导供应商，这使其对全行业算力分配具有影响力。

The same wallet later lost $450,000 when 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night after having been held open for more than three hours.

The report frames the episode as a concrete cross-venue price-manipulation vector touching Hyperliquid, one of the largest perpetual futures DEXs, rather than a routine trading loss.

The 30 short positions were liquidated on Saturday night, more than three hours after they were opened.
metadata.background_en: Papertrade is a synthetic perpetual futures DEX built on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM that advertises leverage of up to 1,000x and, according to reports dated Oct. 10, 2026, had attracted roughly $118 million in deposits and total value locked. Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain whose HyperCore component processes orderbook-based perpetual futures trading, while HyperEVM handles EVM-compatible smart contracts.
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through Hyperliquid's ETH perpetual markets: if a newly launched high-leverage venue can move the mark price used by HyperCore, traders and the liquidation engine there are exposed through the price-feed channel rather than through direct protocol losses. The episode also bears on how leverage caps and oracle design are evaluated for synthetic perp venues built on HyperEVM.

metadata.title_en: Tokenized Stocks Show Real Demand But Remain Volatile and Illiquid, IMF Finds
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The IMF's latest Global Financial Stability Report found that more than 50% of tokenized stock trading occurs outside regular U.S. market hours and that about 80% of trades are for less than a full share, while tokenized equities were roughly 1.5 times more volatile and less liquid than the underlying stocks. The report, covering the five most liquid tokenized U.S. equities across 11 trading venues over 365 days, says systemic risks remain limited for now and urges regulators to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading.

The IMF said it urged regulators to consider circuit breakers for 24/7 trading and to monitor links between tokenized and traditional markets more closely, while noting that systemic risks remain limited for now. It also said its findings "should be interpreted with caution" given the market's early stage.

The tokenized equity market is worth about $2.3 billion and highly concentrated, with Ondo Finance and Backed Finance's xStocks accounting for more than 70% of it; both issue synthetic tokens offering price exposure without direct share ownership. When traditional markets reopened, conventional shares absorbed 87% to 99% of the overnight price moves their tokenized counterparts had made, and tokenized prices on decentralized exchanges strayed further from traditional markets.
metadata.background_en: The report lands as U.S. financial heavyweights push into tokenization: the NYSE plans to reach crypto investors through Blockchain.com, NYSE owner ICE is working with OKX on 24/7 tokenized stock trading under the SEC's new innovation exemption, Securitize has brought tokenized Nvidia, Apple and Amazon shares to Solana, Cboe struck an S&P deal for tokenized options, and Coinbase launched tokenized stocks for non-U.S. users on Base in August. Earlier this year, the IMF warned that tokenized finance and stablecoins could amplify financial crises.
metadata.market_impact_en: The report focuses regulatory attention on market-structure questions for tokenized equities — 24/7 trading hours, circuit breakers and links to traditional venues — which could shape disclosure and trading rules for issuers such as Ondo Finance and Backed Finance and for the exchanges and DEXs where their tokens trade. Its finding that tokenized markets remain small, concentrated and thinly liquid bears on how much contagion risk these venues pose to underlying equity markets.
metadata.title_zh: IMF发现：代币化股票需求真实，但仍波动剧烈且流动性不足
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
国际货币基金组织（IMF）最新《全球金融稳定报告》发现，超过50%的代币化股票交易发生在美国常规交易时段之外，约80%的交易不足一整股；同时代币化股票的波动率约为标的股票的1.5倍，流动性也明显更差。该报告覆盖了11个交易平台、365天内流动性最好的五只代币化美股，认为目前系统性风险仍然有限，并敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易设置熔断机制。

IMF表示已敦促监管机构考虑为24/7交易引入熔断机制，并更密切地监测代币化市场与传统市场之间的联系，同时指出目前系统性风险仍然有限。鉴于该市场仍处于早期阶段，IMF还称其结论“应谨慎解读”。

代币化股票市场规模约23亿美元且高度集中，Ondo Finance与Backed Finance的xStocks合计占据逾70%份额；两者发行的均为合成代币，提供价格敞口但不涉及直接持股。传统市场重新开盘时，常规股票吸收了其代币化对应资产隔夜价格波动的87%至99%，而去中心化交易所上的代币化价格偏离传统市场更大。
metadata.background_zh: 报告发布之际，美国金融巨头正加速进入代币化领域：纽约证券交易所计划通过Blockchain.com触达加密投资者；纽交所母公司ICE正与OKX合作，在美国证券交易委员会（SEC）新的创新豁免框架下开展24/7代币化股票交易；Securitize已将代币化的英伟达、苹果和亚马逊股票引入Solana，并计划接入更多区块链网络；Cboe与标普达成代币化期权协议；Coinbase则于8月在Base上为美国以外用户推出代币化股票。今年早些时候，IMF曾警告代币化金融与稳定币可能放大金融危机。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该报告将监管注意力引向代币化股票的市场结构问题——24/7交易时段、熔断机制以及与传统交易场所的联动——这可能影响Ondo Finance、Backed Finance等发行方以及其代币所交易的中心化与去中心化平台的披露与交易规则。报告指出代币化市场规模小、集中度高且流动性薄弱，这关系到此类场所对标的股票市场构成多大传染风险。

metadata.title_en: Terence Tao: Math 2.0 [pdf]
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Terence Tao has published the slides for his Caltech 2026 talk "Math 2.0", which lays out the historical "Math 1.0" state of mathematics and the current state that AI is inducing in the field. Tao's blog post accompanying the talk is dated 10 October 2026 and notes the Caltech talk was postponed to October and changed significantly in light of recent events.

The slides offer a prominent mathematician's framing of how AI is changing mathematical practice and theory, and the accompanying Hacker News thread drew unusually heavy engagement (288 points, 349 comments).

The slides reference the Inverse Galois Problem challenge (2026), whose first stage, IGP24, was a crowdsourced competition to locate degree-24 polynomials covering each of the 25,000 possible Galois groups at that degree. Tao's blog post is filed under math.GM as a talk entry.
metadata.background_en: Tao is a Fields Medalist mathematician, and his personal blog is where he posts talk notes and commentary. His blog states that the Caltech talk was postponed and substantially revised following recent events, and Hacker News commenters link its content to an October 8 batch of AI-produced mathematical solutions.
metadata.community_discussion_en: Commenters debated Tao's medical analogy: dekhn, who says he works in drug discovery and AI, called the cancer-medicine slide poorly informed and noted that models of how drugs work remain incomplete, while squidmaster argued "Tao is out of his lane" because many medicines lack fully understood mechanisms, citing general anesthesia. thomasahle recast Tao's argument in software terms — pure mathematics as a "codebase" of theory, definitions and proofs, with open problems as "lighthouses not destinations" — and said current math AI is not a "good citizen". samuelknight summarized reactions to the October 8 AI batch as researchers finding years-old problems solved, having to rewrite just-submitted grant requests, and mourning the loss of a field.
metadata.title_zh: 陶哲轩：数学 2.0 [pdf]
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
陶哲轩（Terence Tao）公开了其在加州理工学院 2026 年演讲《数学 2.0》的幻灯片，梳理了历史上的“数学 1.0”状态，以及 AI 正在给数学带来的当前状态。随演讲发布的博客文章日期为 2026 年 10 月 10 日，并指出该演讲被推迟到 10 月，且因近期事件而大幅修改。

这份幻灯片提供了一位知名数学家对 AI 如何改变数学实践与理论的框架性看法，相关 Hacker News 讨论帖获得了异常高的参与度（288 分、349 条评论）。

幻灯片刻意提到了“逆伽罗瓦问题挑战（2026）”，其第一阶段 IGP24 是一场众包竞赛，目标是找出覆盖 24 次多项式全部 25,000 个可能伽罗瓦群的实例。陶哲轩的博文被归入 math.GM 分类，类型标注为 talk（演讲）。
metadata.background_zh: 陶哲轩是菲尔兹奖得主数学家，其个人博客是他发布演讲笔记与评论的场所。博文称该加州理工演讲被推迟，并因近期事件而大幅调整；Hacker News 的评论者则将演讲内容与 10 月 8 日一批由 AI 生成的数学解答联系起来。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 评论者就陶哲轩使用的医学类比展开争论：自称从事药物发现与 AI 工作的 dekhn 认为其中关于癌症医学的幻灯片“信息不足”，并指出关于药物作用机制的模型与叙述仍极不完整；squidmaster 则认为陶哲轩“越界了”，因为许多药物（如全身麻醉剂）的作用机制本就没有完全弄清。thomasahle 用软件术语重新表述了陶哲轩的论点——纯数学是在构建和维护由理论、定义与证明组成的“代码库”，未解问题是“灯塔而非终点”——并称当前这一代数学 AI 还不是“好公民”。samuelknight 总结了人们对 10 月 8 日那批 AI 成果的反应：有人多年未解的问题被解决，有人不得不重写刚提交的基金申请，也有人像失去故友一般哀叹一个领域的逝去。

metadata.title_en: Coinbase Stock and 2 Trading Platforms Facing a CFTC Rule Shift
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A Simply Wall Street analysis reports that a CFTC rule change is poised to affect Coinbase and two other trading platforms, drawing regulatory and stock-market attention. The piece is framed as stock analysis; the other two platforms are not named in the headline or summary.

Per the CFTC's own description, the proposed Regulation CTX and Regulation CAM would establish requirements for CFTC-registered exchanges that offer crypto assets for trading, which is the compliance channel through which listed US crypto venues could be affected.

The proposed rulemaking package, titled "Regulation Crypto Asset Transactions and Regulation Crypto Asset Markets," was submitted to the White House Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs on September 17, 2026 for regulatory review. In a CFTC-published statement, the agency said these regulations would not require crypto assets to trade on CFTC-registered platforms, a step it said it lacks authority to impose without congressional action.
metadata.background_en: Coinbase has been assembling a CFTC-regulated US derivatives stack: on September 28, 2026 the CFTC registered Coinbase Clearing LLC as a Derivatives Clearing Organization, which the company said completed its derivatives platform alongside its futures commission merchant and designated contract market. The CTX and CAM package remains a proposal under review, not a final rule.
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission path is regulatory rather than direct: rules setting requirements for CFTC-registered venues that list crypto assets could bear on compliance costs and product scope at US-facing platforms and, through sentiment, on related crypto equities; the package is still under review, so the scope of any impact depends on the final rule text.
metadata.title_zh: Coinbase股票及另外两家交易平台面临CFTC规则变动
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:

按照CFTC自身的说明，拟议的《加密资产交易规则》（Regulation CTX）与《加密资产市场规则》（Regulation CAM）将为提供加密资产交易的CFTC注册交易所设定要求，这正是美国上市加密交易平台可能受影响的合规传导渠道。

这份名为《加密资产交易规则与加密资产市场规则》的拟议规则包已于2026年9月17日提交白宫信息与监管事务办公室（OIRA）进行监管审查。CFTC在公开发表的声明中表示，这些规则不会要求加密资产必须在CFTC注册平台上交易，并称若无国会立法，该机构无权施加此类要求。
metadata.background_zh: Coinbase一直在搭建受CFTC监管的美国衍生品业务体系：2026年9月28日，CFTC将Coinbase Clearing LLC注册为衍生品清算机构（DCO），公司称这与其期货佣金商（FCM）和指定合约市场（DCM）共同构成了完整的衍生品平台。CTX与CAM规则包目前仍处于审查中的提案阶段，尚未成为最终规则。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导路径是监管层面的，而非直接的市场冲击：为提供加密资产交易的CFTC注册平台设定要求，可能影响面向美国市场的交易平台的合规成本与产品范围，并通过市场情绪波及相关加密概念股；该规则包仍在审查之中，实际影响范围取决于最终规则文本。

metadata.title_en: Nasdaq-listed company SVRN acquires NEAR infrastructure provider FastNEAR

Nasdaq-listed SVRN announced it has acquired FastNEAR, a provider of NEAR RPC, archival and data infrastructure; the purchase price was not disclosed. FastNEAR becomes a wholly owned subsidiary and SVRN's first operating business alongside its asset treasury, with FastNEAR co-founders Evgeny Kuzyakov and Mike Purvis joining SVRN.

The deal moves a public-market company beyond treasury-holding into operating crypto infrastructure, and places stewardship of widely used NEAR endpoints and data services under a Nasdaq-listed owner.

FastNEAR handles more than 3.5 billion requests per month and provides over 100 TB of data services. After the acquisition, its RPC service, archival infrastructure and NEARDATA will continue to be operated by the original team, and SVRN said it plans to invest further in system reliability and service capacity.
metadata.background_en: FastNEAR describes itself as a high-performance NEAR Protocol infrastructure provider offering an RPC gateway, including a free public tier, as well as NEARDATA, which provides streaming access to NEAR blockchain blocks and data via REST APIs. NEAR documentation lists Neardata as the direct replacement for the discontinued NEAR Lake S3 indexing service for new projects.
metadata.market_impact_en: The deal concentrates a widely used NEAR RPC, archival and NEARDATA provider under a Nasdaq-listed owner, which could affect how NEAR ecosystem developers and applications source endpoint access and block data if service terms or capacity change; it also adds a public-equity channel into crypto infrastructure operations. Any effect on the NEAR token would come indirectly through infrastructure reliability and ecosystem sentiment rather than through token supply or a listing event.

dedup_history.author: davikr

metadata.title_en: 500B tokens later: Letting AI agents decompile a first-person shooter
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Developer momo5502 published a blog post describing an experiment in which AI agents consumed roughly 500 billion tokens to decompile a commercial first-person shooter down to byte-matching assembly. The post, which drew a large Hacker News thread, discusses the cost, the agent architecture used, and whether functional equivalence would have been enough.

The post provides a concrete, large-scale datapoint on the cost of agentic LLM workflows, attaching a 500-billion-token figure to a single reverse-engineering project. Commenters read it as evidence that byte-matching decompilation is a deliberately expensive target compared with functional equivalence.

Byte-matching (matching) decompilation means writing original C++ that, compiled with the era-correct toolchain, produces byte-for-byte the same machine code as the shipped binary. According to a commenter quoting the post, two earlier posts by the author have since been removed.
metadata.background_en: Matching decompilation is an established reverse-engineering discipline in which the goal is a compiled artifact identical to the original binary. Agent-based reverse-engineering tooling for coding agents has also been emerging, and academic work such as the Faultless paper addresses program equivalence for neural decompilation. Commenters noted the author has roughly a decade of modding experience with the game in question and prior work on game exploits.
metadata.community_discussion_en: In a roughly 101-comment Hacker News thread, the dominant view was that the byte-matching goal, not the agents, drove the cost: several commenters argued functional equivalence would use far fewer tokens, with one describing a workflow where an agent writes semantically equivalent code plus tests instead. Others focused on agentic architecture, arguing there is still no substitute for human taste in complex systems, and one questioned the model choice as a false economy.
metadata.title_zh: 消耗 5000 亿 token 之后：让 AI 智能体反编译一款第一人称射击游戏
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
开发者 momo5502 发布博文，描述了一项实验：AI 智能体消耗约 5000 亿个 token，将一款商业第一人称射击游戏反编译到字节级一致的汇编代码。该文在 Hacker News 上引发大量讨论，内容涉及成本、所用的智能体架构，以及功能性等价是否足够。

这篇博文为智能体式 LLM 工作流的成本提供了一个具体的大规模样本，把 5000 亿 token 的消耗与单个逆向工程项目直接挂钩。评论者将其视为一个证据：与追求功能性等价相比，字节级一致的反编译是一个刻意昂贵的目标。

字节级一致（matching）反编译指的是编写原创 C++ 代码，并用与当年一致的编译工具链编译，使其生成的机器码与已发布的二进制文件逐字节相同。一位评论者引用博文称，作者此前发布的两篇文章已被删除。
metadata.background_zh: 字节级一致的反编译是一项成熟的逆向工程实践，其目标是编译产物与原始二进制完全一致。面向编码智能体的逆向工程工具也在陆续出现，而诸如 Faultless 论文等学术工作则专门研究神经反编译中的程序等价性问题。评论者指出，作者对所涉游戏拥有约十年的模组（modding）经验，并曾从事该游戏的漏洞挖掘工作。
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 在约 101 条评论的 Hacker News 讨论中，主流观点认为推高成本的是字节级一致这一目标本身，而非智能体：多位评论者认为若只追求功能性等价，token 消耗会低得多，其中一人描述了自己的工作流——让智能体编写语义等价但不完全相同的代码并附带测试。另有一些讨论聚焦智能体架构，认为在复杂系统中人类的品味仍无可替代；还有人质疑模型选择，认为那是“虚假的节约”。

metadata.title_en: DistroKid has been quietly taking down songs in response to UMG lawsuit
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
DistroKid has confirmed to The Verge that it is removing artists' songs in direct response to claims made by Universal Music Group, which sued the distributor in September. Affected musicians say their tracks were taken down without notice.

The removals show a pending copyright lawsuit translating directly into catalog takedowns for independent artists, before any court ruling. Artists whose releases have already been distributed are the ones absorbing the immediate impact.

UMG's September suit accuses DistroKid of running an "AI-slop pipeline" and of allowing unlicensed remixes of UMG tracks onto streaming services; DistroKid has denied the claims and said it would defend itself. The takedowns, per the company, are a response to those claims rather than the result of a court order.
metadata.background_en: DistroKid is a US independent digital music distribution service founded in 2012 by Philip J. Kaplan, delivering releases to Spotify, Apple Music, TikTok and 150-plus platforms. UMG filed its suit in the fall, alleging that mass-produced AI-generated material and unlicensed content siphon revenue and listeners away from legitimate artists and rightsholders.
metadata.market_impact_en: The dispute runs through distribution and rights clearance, the layer that gates how much AI-generated music reaches streaming services; takedown policies at major distributors can change the volume of AI-made tracks entering royalty pools on Spotify, Apple Music and similar platforms. It also raises questions about liability exposure for distributors handling large volumes of automated uploads.
metadata.title_zh: DistroKid 一直在悄悄下架歌曲，以回应 UMG 的诉讼
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
DistroKid 向 The Verge 确认，正在下架艺人的歌曲，此举是对环球音乐集团（UMG）相关指控的直接回应——UMG 已于9月起诉这家分销商。受影响的音乐人表示，他们的作品在未获通知的情况下被下架。

这些下架动作显示，一场尚未判决的版权诉讼已直接转化为独立艺人作品目录的移除。已经发行过作品的艺人首当其冲，承担了最直接的影响。

UMG 在9月的诉讼中指控 DistroKid 运营一条“AI 垃圾内容流水线”，并允许未经授权的 UMG 歌曲混音版本上传至流媒体平台；DistroKid 否认了这些指控，并表示将为自己辩护。据该公司称，此次下架是对上述指控的回应，而非法院命令的结果。
metadata.background_zh: DistroKid 是一家美国独立数字音乐分销服务商，由 Philip J. Kaplan 于2012年创立，可将作品投放到 Spotify、Apple Music、TikTok 等 150 多个平台。UMG 在秋季提起诉讼，称大批量生产的 AI 生成内容与未经授权的内容正在从合法艺人和权利人手中抽走收入与听众。
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这一争议的传导路径在于分销与权利清算环节——它决定有多少 AI 生成音乐能够进入流媒体平台。大型分销商的下架政策会改变流入 Spotify、Apple Music 等平台版税池的 AI 曲目数量，同时也让处理大量自动化上传的分销商面临责任敞口问题。

According to a CoinMarketCap explainer, Raydium's RAY token saw sharp price swings that the report attributes to a new Coinbase listing combined with fresh SEC guidance affecting the token's market access and trading backdrop. The item is presented as a volatility explainer rather than as a primary exchange or regulatory announcement.

The report links RAY's price swings to a listing on a top-tier US exchange, which would widen the venues through which the token can be traded, alongside SEC guidance that the article says shapes its market access.

The piece is framed as an explainer of volatility rather than a first-party announcement of the listing or the guidance. CoinGecko data cited in search results put Raydium's market capitalization near $540 million, ranked around 111th among tokens.
metadata.background_en: Raydium is a decentralized exchange and automated market maker built on Solana, and RAY is its governance token, used for transaction fees, staking and liquidity-pool rewards. Coinbase states that it applies a standard listing process before enabling transfers and moving an asset into trading mode. The SEC has recently issued guidance aimed at token issuers.
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through market access and venue liquidity: a Coinbase listing would broaden the set of US-accessible buyers and sellers for RAY, while SEC guidance shapes how such tokens are treated by regulated venues. Raydium sits in the Solana DEX governance segment, so any change in its tradability is most directly reflected in RAY spot markets and on Solana-based trading venues.
